item.title: 'Night turned into day': Iranians tell of strikes on oil depots
item.summary: Fuel depots were hit in Tehran and Karaj overnight, with videos showing huge fires and plumes of smoke in multiple locations.

item.title: Australia urged to protect Iranian football team after Asian Cup elimination
item.summary: Concern has grown for team after one critic called them 'wartime traitors' for failing to salute during the Iranian anthem.

item.title: In maps: Ten days of strikes across the Middle East
item.summary: Israel has continued strikes across Iran and Lebanon and the Iranian regime has carried out more attacks, as the war continues for a tenth day.

item.title: Call off King's US visit over Iran, urge Lib Dems
item.summary: The party says the planned trip should be scrapped after Donald Trump's criticism of the UK's response to the war.

item.title: Watch: Ukrainian anti-drone 'bullet' that could help defend Gulf
item.summary: The BBC's Diplomatic Correspondent, James Landale, is in Ukraine to see the latest anti-drone technology the country has to offer.

item.title: Images of face released in bid to solve mystery of man found dead in wetsuit
item.summary: Detectives hope the new facial reconstruction images will end an 18-month mystery.

item.title: Who is Mojtaba Khamenei, Iran's new supreme leader?
item.summary: Many expect the 56-year-old, who has largely kept a low profile, to continue his father's hardline policies.

item.title: 'He's the dog of a lifetime': Bruin the Clumber spaniel wins best in show at Crufts
item.summary: Handler Lee Cox said Bruin was the "dog of a lifetime" as he accepted the award.

item.title: IRA bomb victims' civil court case begins against Gerry Adams
item.summary: The men are seeking a ruling that Adams is personally liable for decisions to plant car bombs in London and Manchester in 1973 and 1996.

item.title: Paddington first new musical to win nine WhatsOnStage awards in 'record-setting haul'
item.summary: Other winners at the event included Jonathan Bailey, Rachel Zegler, Amber Davies and Sir Stephen Fry.
